gaps.quote: cheap enough for a fixed-tape machine
gaps.note: The reader knows basic multitape Turing machines but not the fixed-tape model. The page neither explains it nor links to the fixed-tape model page, so the purpose of the transform cannot be placed.

gaps.term: roots of unity of the synthetic transform are powers of y
gaps.quote: The transform's roots of unity are therefore powers of $y$ (cited).
gaps.note: This is presented as following ('therefore') from the twiddle-factor description, but the page never states which powers of y are the roots, why they satisfy the root-of-unity condition in Z[y]/(y^r+1) (for example via y^{2r}=1), or what the transform's n is. The reader cannot check this from the page; the citation does not say how the page's own concept works.

gaps.term: the claim shown by the method

gaps.note: The claim is never stated on this page, so the reader cannot tell what is being shown or check that the butterfly description establishes it.
